messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm drafting relnotes for Adaptive Batching v2 + smart-routing tweaks. Need sign-off on copy, a short known-issues blurb, and updated SDK snippets. Targeting deploy tomorrow morning. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 :wave:
sam: Thanks — can you paste the Python snippet you'll publish? want to sanity-check usage of `batching='auto'` and the streaming example. :eyes:
maya: sure, pasting current snippets below (preview in markdown):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=... )
resp = client.generate("Summarize the page", batching='auto', max_tokens=200)
print(resp.text)
```
And a tiny Go example: 
```go
client := redwood.NewClient("$API_KEY")
resp, _ := client.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.GenerateParams{Input: "Summarize the page", Batching: redwood.BatchingModeAuto})
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```
liam: CI flagged one broken example in /examples/streaming.md — the streaming shape changed (now returns fragments with `part` and `is_final`). I'll open a patch to update that doc. @maya can you add a short breaking-change note to the relnotes?
anya: FYI link-checker found two anchor breakages after the recent restructure: `/api/#generate` -> `/api/reference/#generate`. I'll push redirects, but should we call this out under Known issues or just fix silently?
doc-editor: Proposed tiny known-issue blurb (for relnotes):
"Users upgrading from 1.7 may observe truncated/duplicate token fragments when using streaming with very short client timeouts. Workaround: increase client timeout to >=100ms or disable streaming. A runtime patch is queued for the next release."
sam: wording tweak: change 'truncated/duplicate token fragments' -> 'truncated or duplicated token fragments' and add a short repro note? otherwise :thumbsup:
rachel: Repro note would be helpful but keep it one sentence. Also we should call out SDK versions that include the fix (e.g., python >=0.19.1).
dev-docs-bot: CI: docs build passed; linkcheck: 2 warnings (anchors moved). Build #7890 — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/7890 :white_check_mark:
maya: Updated PR text with the edited blurb and added the Python/Go snippets. Also inserted a frontmatter tag `<!-- relnote: adaptive-batching-v2 -->` to help the publish script. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521/files :point_up:
liam: LGTM. Small nit in Go snippet: use the exported const `redwood.BatchingModeAuto` (not string). I'll push a tiny commit to the PR. :+1:
maya: thanks — I'll wait 30m for any last comments and then merge at 11:30 PT if no objections. After merge I'll trigger the relnotes publish workflow. @rachel can you draft the social copy once it's merged? :calendar:
rachel: Yep — I'll draft a 1-2 line announcement + quick bullet about the streaming caveat and share to #marketing in ~30m. :memo:
